title: NIT Silchar Notification 2026 - Apply Online for Post Doctoral Fellow Posts
description: The National Institute of Technology Silchar (NIT Silchar) has issued the official notification for the recruitment of Postdoctoral Fellow I positions. Candidates who have qualified in postgraduate studies or a Ph.D. can grab this chance and apply for the NIT Silchar Notification 2026 . Here we have included the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts. Interested and eligible candidates can apply before the last date...
